title: Concrete local root algebra and auxiliary transverse section trait
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, $\sigma:S\to C$ a section, and $G$ a finite group with order invertible in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product], with a section $s_\eta$ satisfying $q s_\eta=1$ and $j s_\eta=\sigma a_\eta$. Let $Z\to C_\eta$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor without any rational-point assumption. Let $U\subset S$ contain $\eta$, let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale, and let $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit its generic restriction, with $i_Uj_U=j$. Let $s\notin U$ be such that every $t\notin U$ specializing to $s$ equals $s$. Put $a:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $l:L\to C$, and let $N\to C$ be the concrete relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$. Let $\tau=(a\sigma,1):\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to L$ be the induced section. Assume $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ is a discrete valuation ring and that $n:N\times_C L\to L$ is finite. For each point $x$ of $N\times_C L$ with $n(x)=\tau(\mathfrak m_{S,s})$, put $B=\mathcal O_{N\times_C L,x}$ and $J=\mathfrak m_{L,n(x)}B$. There exist a commutative local ring $R$, $f\in\mathfrak m_R$ and $e>0$. Put $D=R[T]/(T^e-f)$, concretely the AdjoinRoot quotient. The ring $D$ is local, and there is a flat local map $\beta:B\to D$. The canonical map $i:R\to D$ is local and $J D=\mathfrak m_R D$, where the first extension is along $\beta$ and the second along $i$. There also exist a discrete valuation ring $A'$ (a nonfield local principal ideal domain), its fraction field $K$, an irreducible element $\varpi\in A'$, a unit $\pi\in K^\times$ with $\pi=\varpi$ under the fraction-field embedding, and $b:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$. There is an open immersion $g:\operatorname{Spec}(K[T]/(T^e-\pi))\to Z\times_{C_\eta}\operatorname{Spec}K$ along $s_\eta b$, whose composite with the projection to $\operatorname{Spec}K$ is the canonical structural map. No maximal-ideal formula for $D$, power-membership assertion for its root, or integer-valued valuation is part of this statement.

proof.text: Use the localized geometric chart and its transverse generic factor. This supplies R, f in its maximal ideal, e positive, a maximal ideal P of D=R[T]/(T^e-f), the local flat map B to D_P, the ideal equality in D_P, and a generator varpi of the auxiliary DVR maximal ideal with its generic open factor.

Prove D local: the monic root polynomial makes D finite integral over R. Any maximal ideal M of D contracts to the unique maximal ideal of R. The relation t^e=f puts t in M. Decompose any polynomial q as its constant coefficient plus T times a polynomial. Membership of q(t) in M is thus equivalent to membership of q(0) in the base maximal ideal, independently of M. Therefore all maximal ideals equal P and D is local. Integrality also gives the contraction identity for its maximal ideal, hence the canonical map R to D is local.

Since P is the maximal ideal of the local ring D, all elements outside P are units. The canonical localization map D to D_P is an isomorphism. Compose beta with its inverse. Ring isomorphisms are local and flat, so the new beta is local and flat. Map the ideal equality along the inverse and use composition of ideal maps and the inverse structural-map identity. This proves the required equality in the whole root algebra D.

In the auxiliary DVR, a generator of its maximal ideal is irreducible by Mathlib IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer. Preserve all generic-factor witnesses and their structural-map equality unchanged.

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_trait_section_root_presentation {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a :=
      pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
    IsFinite n → ∀ x : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
      (pullback.fst c a) : Scheme.{u}),
      n x = τ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (S.presheaf.stalk s)) →
      let B := (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
        (pullback.fst c a)).presheaf.stalk x
      let J := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pullback c a).presheaf.stalk (n x))).map
        (n.stalkMap x).hom
      ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsLocalRing R) (f : R) (e : ℕ),
        0 < e ∧ f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∧
        let p := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e - Polynomial.C f
        let D := AdjoinRoot p
        ∃ (_ : IsLocalRing D) (β : B →+* D),
          IsLocalHom β ∧ β.Flat ∧ IsLocalHom (AdjoinRoot.of p) ∧
          J.map β = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (AdjoinRoot.of p) ∧
          ∃ (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsDomain A) (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing A)
            (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (_ : Algebra A K) (_ : IsFractionRing A K)
            (ϖ : A) (π : Kˣ) (b : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec S.functionField),
            Irreducible ϖ ∧ (π : K) = algebraMap A K ϖ ∧
            ∃ g : Spec (CommRingCat.of
                (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ^ e - Polynomial.C (π : K)))) ⟶
                pullback Z.π (b ≫ sη),
              IsOpenImmersion g ∧
              g ≫ pullback.snd Z.π (b ≫ sη) =
                Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K
                  (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ^ e -
                    Polynomial.C (π : K)))))
